name: token-usage-total
description: Sum token usage across agent-run JSONL transcripts. Reads every *.jsonl in the given directory (default data/), keeps only message entries whose payload.role is 'assistant' and that carry payload.usage, and totals prompt_cache_hit_tokens, prompt_cache_miss_tokens and completion_tokens (absent fields count as 0). Prints JSON {"hit": n, "miss": n, "out": n}.
